result_summary: Recovered the current truth for Plan de acción / Universal Control without redesign or promotion. The surface is not one implementation: the current Plan de Acción page is a standalone published artifact, while the current served global Prometeo control is owner shell v2 mounted at the root. Universal Control V5 remains valuable historical/migration baseline evidence but is no longer the current root owner.
material_advances: Separated the control-plan surface into two concrete authorities: plan-page and global-control.
Verified byte identity for plan_de_accion_bicolor_v1.html across main and gh-pages and preserved the absence of an independent deep-URL live HTTP check instead of overstating Served status.
Verified the public root and branch bytes point to persistent owner shell v2, with exact index.html and shell.js blob identities.

Traced the root ownership switch to commit 8c0b93fc2aa398c63dfa346b69163c25d12967ea and classified the Sep-10 Universal Control V5 Golden Master as superseded root-owner history/migration lineage rather than Current.
Identified an explicit authority gap: neither control-plan nor plan_de_accion_bicolor_v1.html is registered in CURRENT_GRAPH or CATALOG_MANIFEST.
Deduplicated the resulting registry/identity and V5-reconciliation needs against active surface-registry, sibling control-plan and cross-surface candidate lanes; emitted no redundant proposal.
non_obvious_findings: The strongest stale-truth trap is the universal-control-v5 work pack: its Served wording is historically correct for 2026-09-10, but a later root-owner switch means it cannot be used as today's root pointer.
owner shell v2 still uses PAGE_ID='prometeo-universal-shell-v5'; this is compatibility naming/lineage, not evidence that V5 is the current implementation.
The swarm surface name couples Plan de Acción and Universal Control conceptually, but they have separate concrete ownership and must remain separate during local integration.
preserved_invariants: Current, Served, Candidate and Historical remain distinct.
Exactly one current global Prometeo owner shell remains the root control.
The Plan de Acción page is not silently promoted into Catalog/Current authority.
V5 regression knowledge is preserved without misclassifying it as the current root owner.
No shared product bytes or authority pointers were changed.
/wc remains canary and is not promoted to production /w.

next_safe_frontier.when: after required control-plan lens returns plus local steward/page-thread prerequisites are durably satisfied
next_safe_frontier.instruction: Consume the truth artifact as a two-component authority map; do not collapse the Plan page and global owner shell or resurrect V5 as current root ownership.

source_freshness_at_return.note: Compiler publication lagged the rapidly moving main branch during this broad canary; exact artifact/blob/commit evidence is used for scoped conclusions.
